original_title: Idéologie et appareils idéologiques d'État (Notes pour une recherche)
note: Portuguese standalone translation of the 1970 essay. Positions, Lenin and Philosophy and On Ideology are larger collections; Sur la reproduction is the longer manuscript, not this essay.

original_title: Histoire et psychanalyse entre science et fiction
note: French collection first published by Gallimard in 1987; Portuguese translation published in 2011. Neither Heterologies nor the individual candidate essays is this collection.

original_title: Misère de la philosophie : réponse à la Philosophie de la misère de M. Proudhon
note: Portuguese translation of the work originally written in French. Choose the French-language candidate rather than The Poverty of Philosophy or the extract in Free Trade.

original_title: Eternos modernos: uma história social da arte e da literatura na Amazônia, 1908–1929
container: Doctoral thesis, Universidade Estadual de Campinas, Instituto de Filosofia e Ciências Humanas, 2001, 315 pp.
note: Actually a doctoral thesis; book is the closest permitted schema kind. Confirmed repository identifier: hdl:20.500.12733/1590961. No LCCN, ISBN, OCLC or DOI confirmed.

id: W:duby georges|histoire des femmes en occident
original_title: Storia delle donne in Occidente
note: Five-volume series edited by Georges Duby and Michelle Perrot, first published in Italian in 1990–1992; French edition 1991–1992. ISBN identifies original volume 1, L’antichità, not the complete set.

original_title: Memórias do cárcere
note: 1975 is a later edition of the posthumous prison memoir first published in 1953.

original_title: Portugal na Monarquia Hispânica (1580–1640)
note: Independent 112-page Livros Horizonte book, first published in Portuguese in 2001, translated by Isabel Cardeal. No separately published French original identified; none of the candidates is this work.

original_title: Une histoire présente
container: René Rémond (ed.), Pour une histoire politique (Paris: Seuil, 1988), pp. 11–32
note: Portuguese chapter Uma história presente, reprinted in the 2003 edition of Por uma história política. Candidate w-1092413 is the whole edited volume, not the chapter.

original_title: On microhistory
container: Peter Burke (ed.), New Perspectives on Historical Writing (Cambridge: Polity, 1991), pp. 93–113
note: Likely Levi’s Sobre a micro-história (Portuguese pp. 133–161). The citation substitutes Burke’s collection title and merges Levi with its editor, Peter Burke. OCLC identifies the containing book; exact intended unit remains uncertain.

id: W:paz|o labirinto da solidao e post scriptum
original_title: O labirinto da solidão e post-scriptum
note: Portuguese combined volume of El laberinto de la soledad (Spanish, 1950) and Posdata (Spanish, 1970), catalogued from 1976 by Zona Octavio Paz. Not just w-209716; w-209720 adds further works. ISBN is recorded for the cited 1984 edition.

original_title: Ensino de História hoje: errâncias, conquistas e perdas
container: Revista Brasileira de História 30, no. 60 (2010), pp. 13–33
note: Journal title has replaced the article title. Likely the article by Marcos Antônio da Silva and Selva Guimarães Fonseca; the truncated citation does not establish this conclusively.

original_title: Desclassificados do ouro: a pobreza mineira no século XVIII
note: The supplied title is only an imprint. Author, 1982 original date and Graal 2004 imprint strongly suggest Desclassificados do ouro, fourth revised edition; ISBN confirms that 2004 edition, but reconstruction remains provisional.

original_title: Ideologias e ciência social: elementos para uma análise marxista
note: Brazilian lectures given in June 1985 and published in Portuguese; distinct from Paysages de la vérité / As aventuras de Karl Marx contra o Barão de Münchhausen. ISBN confirmed in the UnB catalogue for the 1992 printing.

original_title: Ἱστορίαι (Historiai; Histories)
note: Herodotus’s Histories, composed approximately 430 BCE; ancient date is approximate. Exact cited edition/volume is unspecified. Identifier is for Wilson’s 2015 original-Greek text, books I–IV, not an asserted identification of the cited translation.

original_title: Brazil pittoresco: historia, descripções, viagens, instituições, colonisação
note: Later Portuguese edition of the bilingual French–Portuguese work whose text appeared in 1859, with Frond’s album in 1861; the 1941 candidate is an earlier reedition of the same work.

original_title: Verdadeiro método de estudar, para ser útil à República e à Igreja: proporcionado ao estilo e necessidade de Portugal
note: Verney’s two-volume educational treatise, first published in 1746. Confirmed OCLC identifies the later clandestine circa-1751 edition, not the 1746 first impression.

id: W:machado neto|estrutura social da republica das letras
original_title: Estrutura social da república das letras: sociologia da vida intelectual brasileira, 1870–1930
note: A. L. Machado Neto’s 1973 Grijalbo/Edusp monograph, 253 pp. Catalogue record 31280 confirms author, title and date; no LCCN, ISBN, OCLC or DOI could be verified.

id: W:veyne|como se escreve a historia e foucault revoluciona a historia
original_title: Comment on écrit l'histoire, suivi de Foucault révolutionne l'histoire
note: Combined French volume pairs Comment on écrit l’histoire (1971) with Foucault révolutionne l’histoire (1978). Candidate w-303604, Writing History (1984), contains only the first essay; it is not the complete two-text volume cited here.

original_title: Sein und Zeit
note: Portuguese translation of Being and Time. Prefer the German-language candidate over w-180932, the English translation; the candidate’s 1977 date is the Gesamtausgabe edition, not first publication.

original_title: Making Sex: Body and Gender from the Greeks to Freud
note: Inventando o sexo is the 2001 Portuguese translation of Making Sex (1990), not Solitary Sex or The Making of the Modern Body.
